**C7 at the finite-rate column states**

Both Henry bases are evaluated at the bulk state and matched interfacial
fugacity on each finite-rate profile. The column diagnostic supplies the full
interfacial fugacity, including the kinetic drop. The independent resolved-film reference
uses 17 and 33 tabulated loading points, with BVP tolerances of $2\times10^{-6}$
and $2\times10^{-8}$. A score requires convergence at both resolutions,
reference flux change at most $2\times10^{-4}$ relative, and a refined
relative RF-1 defect at most $2\times10^{-7}$. The owner-set C7 flux error
limit is 2% at each state. C7 checks the numerical reduction on these film
states. The ratio does not quantify comparison error against column or
wetted-wall measurements.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1C | 0/68 | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| 2C | 67/68 | n2o | n2o | 0.000 | 0.01019 | 260.2 | 1.203 | 1.09e-06 | 7.51e-07 |
| 3C | 68/68 | n2o | epcsaft | 6.000 | 0.00975 | 361.3 | 0.522 | 1.95e-06 | 9.78e-07 |
| 4C | 67/68 | n2o | epcsaft | 6.000 | 0.01000 | 373.0 | 0.569 | 2.24e-06 | 9.76e-07 |
| 5C | 67/68 | n2o | epcsaft | 6.000 | 0.00600 | 436.9 | 0.453 | 8.48e-07 | 1.02e-06 |

| 7C | 68/68 | n2o | n2o | 6.000 | 0.00976 | 309.6 | 0.639 | 1.06e-06 | 1.36e-06 |

405 of 408 comparisons scored. The largest absolute flux error was 0.01226%
(signed error −0.01226%) at 6.000 m in 6C, using ePC-SAFT Henry on the N₂O
profile ($Ha_i=280.68$, $Ha_i/E_\infty=0.894$). The maximum relative
reference refinement change was $2.24\times10^{-6}$. All scored errors were
below 2%. Three refined references reached the mesh-node limit and remain
unscored. They are the N₂O Henry checks on N₂O profiles for 2C at 3.000 m,
4C at 5.494 m, and 5C at 4.667 m.

The [exact column metrics](results/runs/finite_rate_film_cp3_2026-11-23/column_comparison.json) link each profile and record
its tap temperatures and retained solver outcome. The [Corrected C7 rows](results/runs/finite_rate_film_cp3_2026-11-23/review_ee34295/C7.jsonl)
give both resolutions, $Ha_i/E_\infty$, the refinement change and the
conductance margin at each checked state. These rows supersede the original
C7 rows, which used the manifold equilibrium fugacity. Reaction R5 remains a source
extrapolation above 323.15 K, ion diffusivities remain estimated, and the
solved-state density bias and provisional vapour caloric reference limit
thermal interpretation. This comparison has not been independently reviewed
or promoted for manuscript use.
